purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks.

cases.prompt: why is my model slow on the edge tpu
cases.assert: Runs check_ops.py, reports the partition cut and the CPU-stranded fraction.

cases.prompt: will this onnx model compile for coral
cases.assert: Checks operators in graph order, names the first unsupported one.

cases.prompt: which layers fall back to cpu on my accelerator
cases.assert: Leads with the cut point, not with a count of unsupported operators.

cases.prompt: what does an unsupported operator cost me on an npu
cases.assert: Explains the single-partition rule: everything after the cut runs on CPU.

cases.prompt: check this network before I port it to edge hardware
cases.assert: Runs the check and states the pre-conversion caveats.

cases.prompt: which quantisation format should I pick
cases.assert: Asks which number format to use, not where the graph is cut.
Asks for social copy. No model, no graph, no hardware.

cases.prompt: is this claim proven or still open
cases.assert: Asks about the status of an assertion, not about a network.
